name: Unholy Staff
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 203
Aura moderate evocation CL 8th
Slot none; Price 29,600 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This twisted iron staff bears ominous stains along its length, and ends in a black skull with red gemstone eyes. The staff allows use of the following spells:
Align weapon (evil only, 1 charge)
Detect good (1 charge)
Magic circle against good (2 charges)
Unholy blight (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, align weapon, detect good, magic circle against good, unholy blight; Cost 14,800 gp
